title: Molecular basis of UV lesion binding and repair inhibition by ETS-family transcription factors.
authors: Sivapragasam, Smitha; Terrell, James Ross; van der Vaart, Arjan; Germann, Markus W; Laughery, Marian F; Everly, Michaela E; Adhikari, Shiva P; Hrdlicka, Patrick J; Wyrick, John J; Poon, Gregory M K
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构和分子动力学模拟，揭示了ETS家族转录因子结合UV损伤DNA并抑制修复的分子机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与动态结合机理，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Mutation hotspots in melanoma frequently occur at DNA binding sites of E26 transformation-specific (ETS)-family transcription factors, as ETS factors stimulate the formation of UV-induced cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers (CPDs) while suppressing repair at ETS-bound DNA sites. To elucidate the molecular mechanism by which ETS factors bind to damaged DNA sites and inhibit repair, we investigated the binding of members from the three major classes of the ETS superfamily (Ets1, ELF1, and PU.1) to cognate DNA containing a cis-syn TpT CPD. These site-specific CPDs modulated ETS recognition and repair by a model repair enzyme in a position-dependent manner. Specifically, a deaminated CPD located in a damage hotspot in the ETS binding motif consistently stimulated binding and inhibited T4 PDG (a CPD repair enzyme) by all three paralogs. Co-crystal structures of PU.1 reveal that CPDs and mismatches are recognized within the framework of canonical ETS/DNA complexes. Molecular dynamics simulations in explicit solvent show that CPD introduces compensatory structural dynamics to both the free and ETS-bound states that strongly modify the underlying thermodynamics of recognition. The results offer a molecular basis for how ETS factors induce mutation hotspots in skin cancers and other UV-exposed tissues by binding to CPD-containing sites and inhibiting their repair.
abstract_zh: 黑色素瘤中的突变热点频繁出现在E26转化特异性（ETS）家族转录因子的DNA结合位点，因为ETS因子刺激UV诱导的环丁烷嘧啶二聚体（CPDs）的形成，同时抑制ETS结合DNA位点的修复。为了阐明ETS因子结合受损DNA位点并抑制修复的分子机制，我们研究了ETS超家族三个主要类别成员（Ets1、ELF1和PU.1）与含有顺式-syn TpT CPD的同源DNA的结合。这些位点特异性CPDs以位置依赖方式调节ETS识别和模型修复酶的修复。具体而言，位于ETS结合基序损伤热点中的脱氨基CPD持续刺激所有三个旁系同源物的结合，并抑制T4 PDG（一种CPD修复酶）。PU.1的共晶体结构揭示，CPDs和错配在经典ETS/DNA复合物的框架内被识别。显式溶剂中的分子动力学模拟显示，CPD向自由态和ETS结合态均引入补偿性结构动力学，这强烈修饰了识别的潜在热力学。这些结果为ETS因子如何通过结合含CPD位点并抑制其修复，在皮肤癌及其他UV暴露组织中诱导突变热点提供了分子基础。
